content.subject: Sandbox simulation could cut manual testing
content.draft_text:
Hi Test,
ShipBob’s Simulation Terminal now appears in every sandbox account. That could let operations test fulfillment flows without manual data entry, reducing reconciliation effort before go‑live.
We connect your ERP to the sandbox so every inventory adjustment reconciles without manual steps, eliminating checks and saving time.
Would a brief 15‑minute call next week fit your schedule to explore this?
Zamp
